verdict.rationale: The docs mention a public test relay at cdn.moq.dev/anon and a local demo that starts a relay. Docs also say moq-relay can be deployed anywhere, so a founder could develop and test without a paid service. The pack never calls this a free tier, never states that it is free, and gives no usage limits or pricing, so how far it covers development and early testing is unclear. Missing for 10: explicit free-tier or pricing documentation, stated usage limits or allowances for the public relay, and independent confirmation that development costs nothing.

support.subject: As a founder, a free tier or free usage allowance covers development and early testing

citations.quote: A public test relay runs at `https://cdn.moq.dev/anon`.
The default demo starts a relay, publishes a test video, and opens the web player.
